pattern.description: A new agent reply lands at the bottom of the Conversation Preview panel and the whole chat thread scrolls up inside the fixed panel to make room, earlier messages moving together.
pattern.why_premium: The scroll is short and eased so the thread reads as a live conversation, and the crop keeps the eye on the newest reply instead of jumping the layout.

build_hint.gsap: Wrap the chat thread in an overflow-hidden panel; gsap.fromTo(thread, {y: 0}, {y: -replyHeight, duration: 0.45, ease: 'power2.out'}) while the new reply does gsap.fromTo(reply, {autoAlpha: 0, y: 16}, {autoAlpha: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.4, ease: 'power2.out'}) at the same start.
build_hint.remotion: translateY of the thread = interpolate(spring({frame, fps, config: {damping: 26, stiffness: 160, mass: 1}}), [0, 1], [0, -replyHeight]); reply opacity follows the same spring, all inside a fixed-size overflow:hidden container.

notes: The filmstrip is a cropped close-up of the chat panel; camera.move is none, so the pan_y/scale sums describe the chat scroll, not a camera move. b12 (left-panel scrollbar sliver) changed but is too small to read reliably and was left out.
